content.what_it_is: A manually maintained, dated inventory of FUNWAVE-TVD source files, subroutines/functions/modules, and their direct CALL relationships. It outlines the main time-stepping driver, MPI communication, boundary and dispersion operations, flux construction, initialization, I/O, masking, utilities, mixing, input parsing, nesting, sampling, sponge, statistics, tridiagonal solvers, and wavemaker routines.
entities: bc.F boundary and MPI exchange routines — lines 33-49
fluxes.F reconstruction, flux, wave-speed, and limiter routines — lines 98-151
init.F allocation and initialization routines — lines 153-174
io.F input/output and file routines — lines 176-195
misc.F MPI topology, time-step, diagnostics, and wall time — lines 202-222
mod_input.F INPUT_READ and typed readers — lines 237-257
parallel.F halo exchange and distribution routines — lines 270-294
samples.F initial-condition and solitary-wave routines — lines 296-307
wavemaker.F spectral, regular, irregular, time-series, and viscosity routines — lines 355-381
calls: main: MPI_INIT, READ_INPUT, INDEX, ALLOCATE_VARIABLES, INITIALIZATION, WALL_TIME_SECS, SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY, UPDATE_MASK, EXCHANGE, OneWayCoupling, ESTIMATE_DT, Cal_Dispersion, FLUXES, WIND_EFFECT, SourceTerms, ESTIMATE_HUV, WAVE_BREAKING, ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC, SPONGE_DAMPING, MIXING_STUFF, MAX_MIN_PROPERTY, OUTPUT, CHECK_BLOWUP, MPI_FINALIZE — lines 5-30
BOUNDARY_CONDITION group: EXCHANGE_DISPERSION and EXCHANGE call PHI_COLL; PHI_COLL calls MPI_SEND, MPI_IRECV, MPI_WAITALL — lines 36-48
WAVE_BREAKING calls BREAKING and VISCOSITY_WMAKER — lines 54-56
CAL_DISPERSION calls DERIVATIVE_XX, DERIVATIVE_XY, DERIVATIVE_YY, DERIVATIVE_X, DERIVATIVE_Y — lines 78-83
ESTIMATE_HUV calls GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV, which calls TRIDy_periodic, TRIDy, and TRIDy_ser — lines 89-95
FLUXES calls high-order construction, wave speed, DelxyFun, construction, HLL interface flux, and non-HLL interface flux — lines 101-107
INITIALIZATION calls file loading, initial-condition generators, wavemaker setup, sponge calculations, and coupling initialization — lines 156-171
OUTPUT calls STATISTICS, STATIONS, PREVIEW; READ_INPUT calls MPI_COMM_RANK and four typed readers — lines 178-188
INDEX calls MPI Cartesian topology routines; ESTIMATE_DT and CHECK_BLOWUP call MPI_ALLREDUCE — lines 205-220
INPUT_READ typed readers each call READ_VALUE and CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE — lines 240-255
parallel halo exchanges call MPI_IRECV, MPI_ISEND, MPI_WAITALL; distribution calls MPI_Gather and MPI_Scatter — lines 273-294
TRIDy_periodic and TRIDx/TRIDy call MPI point-to-point operations; TRIDy_periodic also calls TRIDy and TRIDy_ser — lines 334-353
WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION calls spectral-data, time-series, irregular-wave, Cm/Sm, DATA2D Cm/Sm, and TMA Cm/Sm routines — lines 358-364
